# Roadmap

Priority reflects expected value divided by build-and-validation cost, not enthusiasm.
A skill moves to `flagship` only when it has a workflow, at least two references, three
evaluation cases (including a false-positive case), and passing validators.

## Shipped in 0.1.0

- `uniskills-router` — Classifies a request, selects the smallest sufficient skill or pack, assigns depth, and emits an executable routing decision.
- `context-efficiency` — Controls reading strategy, tool-output shaping, evidence reuse, and checkpoint discipline so long tasks stay coherent without waste.
- `evidence-validation` — Audits the claims behind an analysis, assigns evidence labels, and finds unsupported assertions and broken inferences.
- `universal-code-review` — Reviews a change for correctness, contract violations, resource and concurrency hazards, and test gaps, with severity and a merge verdict.
- `root-cause-debugging` — Reconstructs a causal chain from symptom to root cause using ranked falsifiable hypotheses, differential evidence, and interventional confirmation.
- `architecture-design-review` — Evaluates or produces an architecture against quality-attribute scenarios, failure modes, migration cost, and reversibility, ending in a decision record.
- `performance-review` — Determines where execution cost actually comes from and whether performance claims hold, separating measurement from estimate and ranking bottlenecks by decision value.
- `security-review` — Reviews an authorized codebase, change, or design for reachable weaknesses by modelling assets, trust boundaries, and source-to-sink paths.
- `technical-research` — Answers a technical or scientific question from primary sources, with version applicability, contradiction search, source ledger, and explicit confidence.
- `technical-brainstorming` — Generates mechanism-distinct options for an open design question, tests them against explicit criteria, and returns a conditional recommendation with a discriminating experiment.
- `experiment-design-and-falsification` — Converts a claim into a falsifiable experiment with controls, confounders, a pre-declared decision rule, and honest reporting of negative results.
- `reverse-engineering` — Reconstructs the structure and behavior of an authorized artifact from static and dynamic evidence, escalating to ISA and ABI analysis only when the question requires it.

## Next

- **`specification-writing`** (core) — Turns requirements and decisions into an implementable, testable specification with acceptance criteria and explicit non-goals.
- **`test-strategy`** (engineering) — Designs a test portfolio matched to failure risk, with coverage rationale, fixtures, and maintenance cost.
- **`safe-refactoring`** (engineering) — Plans behavior-preserving structural change with characterization tests, staged moves, and rollback points.
- **`api-contract-review`** (engineering) — Reviews API design for compatibility, versioning, error semantics, idempotency, and consumer impact.
- **`database-and-migrations-review`** (engineering) — Reviews schema changes, lock behavior, backfill safety, and rollback for live databases.
- **`threat-modeling`** (security) — Builds an asset-actor-boundary threat model with abuse cases and mitigations before implementation.
- **`dependency-vulnerability-audit`** (security) — Assesses dependency risk including provenance, maintenance, advisory coverage, and install-time behavior.

## Later

- **`task-planning`** (core) — Decomposes a complex task into verifiable steps with dependencies, checkpoints, and abort conditions.
- **`distributed-systems-review`** (systems) — Reviews consistency, partition behavior, retries, idempotency, and failure propagation across service boundaries.
- **`reliability-and-failure-analysis`** (systems) — Quantifies failure modes, error budgets, blast radius, and recovery paths for a running system.
- **`codebase-onboarding-and-mapping`** (engineering) — Builds a navigable map of an unfamiliar repository — entry points, data model, hot paths, and conventions.
- **`secrets-and-configuration-audit`** (security) — Finds secrets exposure and unsafe defaults across config, images, logs, and deployment manifests.
- **`privacy-and-data-flow-review`** (security) — Maps personal data flows, retention, and third-party egress against stated policy.
- **`cryptography-implementation-review`** (security) — Reviews primitive selection, key management, nonce handling, and protocol composition.
- **`cloud-and-infrastructure-security`** (security) — Reviews IAM breadth, network exposure, secret paths, and tenant isolation in cloud infrastructure.
- **`protocol-and-file-format-reconstruction`** (systems) — Recovers field boundaries and message semantics from samples and captures through differential analysis.
- **`binary-diff-and-regression-analysis`** (systems) — Compares builds to locate behavioral change, patched defects, or unexpected code movement.
- **`networking-and-protocol-analysis`** (systems) — Diagnoses connection, TLS, DNS, and application-protocol behavior from captures and metrics.
- **`observability-and-tracing`** (systems) — Designs metrics, logs, and traces that answer operational questions at acceptable cost.
- **`container-and-orchestration-review`** (systems) — Reviews images, resource limits, probes, scheduling, and isolation for correctness and safety.
- **`ml-model-review`** (ai-ml) — Reviews model selection, training data provenance, leakage, evaluation protocol, and failure modes.
- **`data-pipeline-review`** (ai-ml) — Reviews ingestion, schema evolution, backfills, idempotency, and data quality controls.
- **`ai-agent-system-design`** (ai-ml) — Designs agent loops, tool boundaries, context budgets, failure handling, and evaluation harnesses.
- **`prompt-and-context-engineering`** (ai-ml) — Designs instructions, retrieval, and context structure with measurable evaluation.
- **`scientific-research-and-state-of-the-art`** (research) — Extends technical-research with paper-level appraisal, replication status, and formal claim extraction.
- **`reproducibility-review`** (research) — Audits whether a computational result can be re-run from the published artifacts.
- **`technical-writing-review`** (documentation) — Reviews documentation for accuracy, testability, audience fit, and maintainability.

## Backlog

- **`tool-discovery`** (core) — Detects available capabilities and selects tools by expected information value and cost, without inventing availability.
- **`build-ci-cd-review`** (engineering) — Reviews build reproducibility, pipeline privilege, caching correctness, and release safety.
- **`operating-systems-internals`** (systems) — Reasons about scheduling, memory management, syscalls, and kernel-visible behavior.
- **`mathematical-formalization`** (research) — Turns an informal claim into definitions, assumptions, and a checkable derivation.
- **`repository-quality-review`** (documentation) — Audits repository hygiene, licensing, contributor paths, and reproducible builds.

## Deferred, with reasons

- **`result-verification`** — Final quality gate over a produced artifact. Deferred because evidence-validation plus the stop conditions in each skill cover the need without a separate invocation.
- **`assembly-machine-code-analysis`** — Intentionally not a standalone flagship. Instruction-level, ABI, and calling-convention analysis is delivered as an on-demand reference inside reverse-engineering, because a separate skill would duplicate its evidence model.
